scope: Model-owned analytical decode-work estimate only. No serving-rate output or hardware traffic claim; no TT imports, HF loads, inference, or device commands.
implemented: Computes physical attention, MLP gate/up, and down projection element counts and applies per-group storage width; lm_head width remains independent.
Preserves the established BFP4 decoder arithmetic branch exactly for baseline and head-only policies.
Accounts for BFP8 KV (1088/1024 bytes per element) and BF16 KV (2 bytes per element) in both estimated reads and writes.
Rejects incomplete/extra weight groups, unsupported labels/cache dtypes, and layer exceptions.

coverage: baseline/head-only weight arithmetic and unchanged non-weight terms
per-group bytes and projection element reconstruction
BF16 KV read and write scaling at 2/(1088/1024)=1.8823529411764706
tests.imports: Host-only benchmark_work and accounting modules; no ttnn import.

runtime_isolation.accuracy_runner_uses_this_estimator: No. The reviewed runner performs model accuracy/runtime checks and does not execute tools/benchmark_work.py.
